reason: No Beaufort Smit owner is named Carel/Sarel Gerhardus. The candidates are Christoffel Johannes, Willem and Frans Petrus, all clearly different given names.
Frans Jacob Labuschagne of Somerset matches Frans Jacobus Labuschagne, declared Somerset, in both given names and district.
Johan David Wentzel of Somerset is an exact name and district match. The genealogy gives no father, so the 'sv Carel David' note does not contradict it.
The name and district match, but C03 is noted 'sv Jan' while the genealogy father is Jacobus Daniel Venter. This strong parentage contradiction points to a different Jan Louis.
No Botha owner in Somerset or Graaff-Reinet is named Hercules (Herculas) David. All candidates have clearly different given names.

The only Albany owner, Andries Christoffel Piek, carries no jr/sr note. This man's father of the same name, the established older farmer, is at least as likely to be the 1830s owner as the son who married in 1832.
Petrus Johannes Botha of George (Uitkyk) is an exact name and district match. He married in 1801, so he was an established adult by the 1830s.
No Pretorius owner bears the given names Zacharias Arnoldus Stephanus or anything resembling them.
Only 'Charl' Viljoen of Uitenhage resembles Carel Johannes, and he has no middle name and is in a different district from the declared Somerset. That is too weak a match to accept.
No Muller owner is named Johannes Christiaan. The candidates (Thomas, Anthony, Georg, Cornelis, a widow) all have clearly different given names, and none is in Somerset.
